title: ResolvedTestCaseVersion
description: The full manifest a runner needs to seed and validate a run, as returned by GET /test-cases/{slug}/versions/{version}. It is the authored test-case version with host-absolute paths rewritten to definition-store-relative `source` keys (a runner has no checkout), references resolved to backend-rendered screenshot URLs rather than mockup source, and the prompt template served inline. Spec and asset bodies are NOT inlined; they are fetched per file from the artifact endpoint using each `source` key.

description.description: The resolved description.md body. Site-facing context, NOT seeded into the workspace.

promptTemplate.description: The prompt.hbs Handlebars source, served inline because the runner renders it locally and it never hits the runner's disk.

assets.description: Asset files seeded into the workspace; authored directories are expanded to one entry per file.

commonReferences.description: Reference views shared by every variant, resolved to rendered screenshots.

BuildCommands.description: The install and build commands run to validate an implementation.

source.description: Store-relative key the runner passes to the artifact endpoint to fetch this file's bytes.

dest.description: Path in the workspace the file is seeded to.

template.description: Whether `source` is a Handlebars (.hbs) template the runner renders before seeding. Defaults to false.

source.description: Store-relative key the runner passes to the artifact endpoint to fetch this file's bytes.

dest.description: Path in the workspace the file is seeded to.

ResolvedReference.description: A reference view resolved to its backend-rendered screenshot. The runner downloads the PNG, seeds it as the visual target, and uses it as the validation baseline. The runner never receives mockup HTML.

screenshotUrl.description: Backend path to the rendered PNG (GET /test-cases/{slug}/versions/{version}/references/{scope}/{view}.png, scope `_common` or a variant slug).

specs.description: Specs additive to the common specs, same shape.

references.description: References additive to the common references, resolved to rendered screenshots.

Check.description: A declared validation check: drive the implementation through `actions`, capture `view`, and compare against the reference identified by `referenceView`.

actions.description: An internally tagged CheckAction list (each item has a `type`), matching the browser-driver action contract.
